info.title: OpenCRM-Umzug API
info.description: REST API for OpenCRM-Umzug. All endpoints require authentication via Bearer token or session cookie. Responses use envelope format: { data: ... } on success, { error: { code, message } } on error.

BearerAuth.description: API key token. Create via Settings > API Keys. Format: oc_sk_<48 hex chars>

RecordValues.description: Key-value pairs where keys are attribute slugs. Value format depends on attribute type.

capacityPoints.description: Planned number of tasks — the column kept its points name

post.summary: Query records with filters and sorting

matchAttribute.description: Attribute slug to match on (assert mode)

get.summary: Get related records (forward and inverse references)
Get activity feed for a record

200.description: Activity items sorted by date desc

Add a record to a list

200.description: Draft plan with day offsets relative to the project start

delete.summary: Unpin a project for the calling user
